Draw solid segments: A--B along bottom (through E and P), D--C along top (through Q), B--D (through junction near (160,78) and (151,96)), C--B, Q--E, Q--P passing through O, D--A-ish short edge from D to point_13 (94,153) toward A is a solid line (seg_07 from D(143,71) to (86,166)) — include as D to A path only if it reaches A; otherwise keep as measured. Include a small right-angle square mark at D (vertex (144,69)) between arms toward C and toward B/A as measured (mark points (160.5,78.5),(150.8,94.8),(134.5,85.3)). Labels: A, B, C, D, E, P, Q, O placed near their points (A below-left, B below-right, C above-right, D above-left, Q above, O upper-right, E below, P below). Keep point labels exactly as bound. Do not invent extra labels. Use a single scale so the figure fits 526x269 aspect.

params.summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction of the figure (parallelogram ABCD with inner points Q, E, P, O, diagonal D–O–B, Q–E and Q–P edges, right-angle mark at D, and all eight labels A–E, O, P, Q). Best-scored version is v2 (critic score 0.88, topology check passed, all labels present). A later v3 (bold bottom labels) scored 0.82 because the critic saw a doubled stroke near Q from the explicit Q–O leg. The topology check requires the Q–O edge, which conflicts with the critic's suggestion to remove it.
